newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover slipped to 968 million yuan from 1.052 billion yuan on Thursday with the 30-day contract the most actively traded.
Trade was quiet with both banks and short-term financial centres keeping to the sidelines ahead of the weekend, traders said.
"The monthly settlement has been completed so most institutions have an ample supply of funds. That was another factor in today's dull trade," said a trader.
Trade was also thinned by the lack of any cut in bank reserve ratios, despite considerable market talk of such a move by the central bank. Market talk had suggested the move could be made this week.
Traders said they expect rates to hold around current levels in the short-term on a lack of market-moving news.
